apiBoundary: OCC controllers (commercewebservices) delegate to *Facade beans; business logic lives in the ServiceLayer (*Service/*Strategy/DAO), never in controllers — see the repo CLAUDE.md

build.SERVER_CONFIG: . ./setantenv.sh && ant server   # regenerate the Tomcat config after a *.properties or localextensions.xml change
build.TYPE_SYSTEM_UPDATE: . ./setantenv.sh && ant updatesystem   # run with the server STOPPED
build.JUNIT_TENANT_INIT: . ./setantenv.sh && ant yunitinit   # re-run after any *-items.xml change, before integration tests
build.UNIT_TEST: . ./setantenv.sh && ant build && ant unittests -Dtestclasses.extensions=<ext>   # server stopped; 'ant build' first so a newly-added test class is on the runner's classpath (otherwise: 'No tests found' false pass)
build.INTEGRATION_TEST: . ./setantenv.sh && ant build && ant integrationtests -Dtestclasses.extensions=<ext>   # server stopped; run JUNIT_TENANT_INIT first if *-items.xml changed
build.IMPEX_IMPORT: MANUAL: import the file through the HAC ImpEx console (https://localhost:9002/hac → Console → ImpEx Import), paste or upload, then check the result log for rejected rows
build.ADDON_INSTALL: MANUAL: . ./setantenv.sh && ant addoninstall -Daddonnames="<addon>" -DaddonStorefront.yacceleratorstorefront="<storefront-ext>" — then FULL_BUILD; confirm the addon list with the developer first
build.EXTENSION_GEN: MANUAL: . ./setantenv.sh && ant extgen (interactive — it prompts for template, name, and package); then add the extension to localextensions.xml and run FULL_BUILD
build.INITIALIZE: MANUAL: DESTRUCTIVE — '. ./setantenv.sh && ant initialize' drops and recreates the schema and wipes all data. Never run this as part of a slice checkpoint. Ask the developer, confirm the target tenant, and confirm they have a backup or don't need one.

researchLayers.name: extensions
researchLayers.targets: extensioninfo.xml dependency graph, config/localextensions.xml, bin/custom/* layout, addon wiring

researchLayers.name: type-system
researchLayers.targets: *-items.xml custom types/relations/enums, deployment tables, generated model usage

researchLayers.name: web-occ
researchLayers.targets: commercewebservices controllers, *-beans.xml WsDTO/Data, OCC field sets, *Facade beans, accelerator storefront controllers/JSP if present

researchLayers.name: impex-data
researchLayers.targets: resources/impex/, essentialdata/projectdata load order, catalog versions, Solr config

manualVerificationSurfaces: Backoffice — the affected type's editor area and list view
HAC (https://localhost:9002/hac) — ImpEx console, FlexibleSearch console, type-system update log, Monitoring → Logs
OCC endpoint — call it directly (curl/Postman) with a real baseSite and auth token
Storefront URL — the page or flow the change surfaces on
Tomcat console output — hybris/log/tomcat/ or the terminal running hybrisserver.sh
sliceExample: Slice 1: *-items.xml type + service interface/stub + unit test (FULL_BUILD, TYPE_SYSTEM_UPDATE, JUNIT_TENANT_INIT, UNIT_TEST). Slice 2: business logic in the ServiceLayer + any impex data (BUILD, UNIT_TEST, IMPEX_IMPORT). Slice 3: *-beans.xml DTO + OCC endpoint + integration test (FULL_BUILD, SERVER_RESTART, INTEGRATION_TEST).

_notes: Starter profile for an SAP Commerce (Hybris) backend built with raw ant — the most common on-prem setup. Set <ext> to your custom extension(s) after install.
Every verb sources the environment first ('. ./setantenv.sh') because each command runs in a fresh shell — the export does not persist between verbs. Do not strip it.

workingDir is hybris/bin/platform, which is where setantenv.sh, build.xml, and hybrisserver.sh all live. CCv2-style layout with a wrapper directory? Set workingDir to 'core-customize/hybris/bin/platform'.
Windows: swap '. ./setantenv.sh' for 'setantenv.bat' and './hybrisserver.sh' for 'hybrisserver.bat'; keep the ant targets identical.

'ant build' compiles; 'ant all' also regenerates models/extensions ('ant clean all' is the safe full rebuild). Use FULL_BUILD after any *-items.xml or *-beans.xml change, because both generate Java sources into gensrc/.
Run TYPE_SYSTEM_UPDATE and all test verbs with the server STOPPED: updatesystem needs the server down, and the junit tenant shuts down Solr on 8983, which is shared with the live server.

Run 'ant build' before 'ant unittests'/'ant integrationtests' whenever a test class was added — otherwise the runner never sees it and reports a false pass with zero tests. Always read the real test count.
Re-run JUNIT_TENANT_INIT ('ant yunitinit') after any *-items.xml change or integration tests will run against a stale junit tenant schema.
Scope tests to custom extensions with -Dtestclasses.extensions=<ext>; never run the full platform suite unless asked.
INITIALIZE is destructive and deliberately MANUAL — it wipes the database. It must never appear in a slice checkpoint.
ImpEx has no reliable ant target here; IMPEX_IMPORT is MANUAL through the HAC console. If your project wraps imports in a custom ant target, point the verb at it.
Never edit gensrc/, platform/, or OOTB modules — override in custom extensions. Use the Spring alias pattern (defaultMyBean -> myBean). OCC Data/WsDTO classes are generated from *-beans.xml.
Gradle-wrapper project instead (CCv2 with ./gradlew)? Use the sap-commerce-gradle profile.
Pair with the sap-commerce, impex, sap-best-practices, and java-best-practices knowledge skills if this repo carries them.

Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian MCP connector is available in your Claude Code session; 'manual' if Jira exists but is unreachable (paste ticket in; updates written paste-ready); 'none' if there is no Jira.
